service_boundary: Represents OCI Generative AI, not Oracle Database AI features, OCI Data Science model deployments, individual partner models, or those vendors' direct APIs.
regional_controls: Models, on-demand access, imported-model support, and dedicated cluster shapes are region-specific OCI resources.
retention_controls: Oracle documents that stateless inference inputs and outputs are not retained by OCI Generative AI. Projects and agent-related state expose separate configurable retention for responses and conversations.
routing: Customers select models and OCI regions; the platform does not present automatic cross-provider routing as its primary contract.
customization: Fine-tuned and imported models can run on dedicated AI clusters with customer-tenancy controls.
strengths: On-demand and dedicated serving coexist with imported-model and fine-tuning paths.
Oracle publishes explicit stateless inference data-handling guidance.
tradeoffs: Model and capacity support varies by OCI region.
Dedicated clusters require commitments and service-limit planning.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: OCI Generative AI data-handling page, for OCI Generative AI

upstream_disclosure.note: The data-handling FAQ states plainly: "Does OCI Generative AI share prompts and responses, fine-tuning training data, or fine-tuned custom models with third-party model providers such as Cohere, Meta, xAI, or Google Vertex AI? No."
upstream_disclosure.scope: OCI Generative AI data-handling page, for OCI Generative AI

credential_handling.note: The service offers no customer-supplied upstream-key path: "OCI Generative AI API keys are secure credential tokens used to authenticate callers and authorize access to large language models hosted by the OCI Generative AI service."
credential_handling.scope: OCI Generative AI API-keys page, for OCI Generative AI

cache_isolation.note: No prompt or prefix caching feature or scope is documented for OCI Generative AI.
cache_isolation.scope: OCI Generative AI data-handling page, for OCI Generative AI

vulnerability_disclosure.note: Oracle's company-wide vulnerability reporting page states the route for customers: "please use your designated support mechanism (e.g., My Oracle Support or SuiteSupport) to submit a service request for any security vulnerability you believe you have discovered in an Oracle product or Cloud or Cloud Services." and a public mailbox for non-customers.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: Oracle vulnerability disclosure page, for OCI Generative AI
